name: ev-skills
description: EV team agent skills, each versioned on its own; `plugins` is generated by `skargo check`

plugins.name: skill-creation
plugins.description: Write, restructure, test or tune an agent skill (a SKILL.md and the files it links). Covers both a skill a repo ships about itself in `docs/skill/`, so agents in other repos can build against its library or framework, and a standalone skill that is its own source of truth: a workflow from the current conversation, a procedure, a domain. Use when asked to make, update, split, review or eval a skill, fix one that does not trigger, or make a project consumable by Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, opencode or other agents.
